data.message: Fisher24: I commit to 18 tons; I invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, but recovery is not guaranteed; this may not maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher, including me. If all 25 follow it, each earns $10,000 this month, 250 tons remain, and stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this protects reliable long-run income instead of risking collapse for a one-time gain. Please state whether you support the cap; catches afterward will show whether we followed it.

I propose 10 tons each this month. Total catch would be 250, leaving 250, so next month's stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields each of us $10,000 monthly without depleting the lake. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan. Please state whether you will do the same; we can review revealed catches afterward.

I propose everyone request 10 tons this month. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That's $10,000 each month indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to do the same; please state your intended cap so we can assess support.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisherman this month and whenever stock is 500. If all 25 comply, we earn $10,000 each and leave 250 tons, guaranteeing a return to 500 under either replenishment outcome. This supports steady income without risking collapse. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to make the same commitment.
